caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate pitcher with a rounded, segmented body divided by vertical grooves. The main color of the pitcher is a rich blue, with alternating vertical panels bordered in gold. About one-third down from the top, a horizontal band encircles the pitcher, containing a cream-colored background with a decorative floral pattern featuring red and blue flowers and gold leaves and stems. The band is bordered on each side with gold scalloped edges and filled with gold mesh designs. The handle on the left is white with gold accents and curves upward before arching down to connect with the pitcher. The spout on the right is wide and fan-shaped with gold lines radiating outward. At the bottom left of the page, there is a small pencil sketch showing the pitcher in a simplified outline, accompanied by handwritten dimensions labeled as "5 in," "7½," and "9½." The background is plain and ivory-colored.
title: Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
